card.name: Science and tech news headlines
card.fires_on: Words inside science and technology news headlines or teasers, such as new devices, materials, energy or space research. It fires on many kinds of words, including nouns, name endings, punctuation and linking words.

modes.label: Headline words
modes.description: Nouns or verbs inside a short tech or science news headline.
modes.example: A not-so-hard graft Transplantable blood<< vessels>> can now be grown as desired AN

modes.label: Partway through technical terms
modes.description: Endings of new technical or science terms in headline lists.
modes.example: Intel's Photodet<<ector>> Aimed at Future Computing Researchers at

modes.label: Punctuation or linking words in science stories
modes.description: A colon, quote mark or small word within science or energy news text.
modes.example: Tapping into ‘extremophiles<<’>> From the various branches of the military

card.writes: Weakly favors words like 'could' and 'algorithms', which fit speculative tech news wording.
card.plain: It marks the wording of science and technology news headlines about new inventions and research.
